quiet:
After the old king died in 1603, the court moved to London.
It was a time of change.

The millers would never give up their idea of a faster mill.
They were stubborn.

I doubt I shall be returning to this part of the record very often.
It is dull.

Betake you to the woods, and let me keep the path, said the traveller.
He left.

You will also find advice for testing the completed installation.
See chapter four.

She walked slowly along the river until the sun went down.
Then she went home.

The letter was written by a friend of the family in Boston.
It arrived late.

They had waited many years for the chance to return home.
Now it came.
